edges.reason: fallback() immediately delegates execution to the internal _fallback routine.
_fallback performs an arbitrary delegatecall to the stored implementation with the raw calldata.
The delegatecall target in _fallback is read from the EIP-1967 implementation slot.
The delegatecalled implementation can call back into the proxy fallback before state settles.
_setImplementation writes the implementation slot through inline assembly sstore.
The sstore in _setImplementation mutates the EIP-1967 implementation slot.
The newImplementation parameter is the value written into the implementation slot.
_setImplementation delegatecalls the caller supplied data against the new implementation.
The data parameter is forwarded as delegatecall payload, allowing arbitrary execution.
The newImplementation parameter is the delegatecall target address.
The delegatecall may re-enter _setImplementation or the proxy entrypoints before completion.
The EIP173Proxy constructor calls _setImplementation to install the first implementation.
The constructor implementationAddress parameter is passed into _setImplementation.
The constructor data parameter is passed into _setImplementation.
The EIP173Proxy constructor calls _setOwner to initialize ownership.
The constructor ownerAddress parameter is passed into _setOwner.
_setOwner writes the owner slot through inline assembly sstore.

The sstore in _setOwner mutates the OWNER_SLOT storage variable.
_owner loads the admin address by reading OWNER_SLOT.
msg.sender is compared against the stored owner inside the require gate.
The owner value returned by _owner is used as the right-hand side of the authorization check.
The onlyOwner modifier guards transferOwnership before its body executes.
The onlyOwner modifier guards changeImplementation before its body executes.

changeImplementation calls _setImplementation to swap the delegatecall target.
